say:1:1330925001:1.text: Apologies, Magister... I'm afraid you'll have to wait.
say:1:1330925001:1.source_cn: 抱歉，魔法师大人……恐怕还不行。
say:1:1330925001:1.male: Apologies, Magister... I'm afraid you'll have to wait.
say:1:1330925001:1.female: Apologies, Magister... I'm afraid you'll have to wait.

say:2:1330925002:1.text: Things are chaotic in the duchy, and we haven't even started preparing for the funeral. Please give us some time to sort things out.
say:2:1330925002:1.source_cn: 公国一片混乱，葬礼的筹备也尚未开始，请先给我们一点时间处理。
say:2:1330925002:1.male: Things are chaotic in the duchy, and we haven't even started preparing for the funeral. Please give us some time to sort things out.
say:2:1330925002:1.female: Things are chaotic in the duchy, and we haven't even started preparing for the funeral. Please give us some time to sort things out.

say:3:1330925003:1.text: We'll make sure the Archduke and the princess have a proper farewell.
say:3:1330925003:1.source_cn: 我们一定会……为大公和公主殿下准备妥善的告别仪式。
say:3:1330925003:1.male: We'll make sure the Archduke and the princess have a proper farewell.
say:3:1330925003:1.female: We'll make sure the Archduke and the princess have a proper farewell.
